# Releases

- `npm run version:bump <version>` sets the version in `package.json`, `src-tauri/Cargo.toml` and `tauri.conf.json`, and turns the Unreleased section of `CHANGELOG.md` into a dated one. Commit, then push a `v<version>` tag.
- `fran-vpn` has its own version in `crates/vpn-worker/Cargo.toml`, bumped by hand when it changes. The installed service reports it, and the app compares it with the one in that file at build time (`FRAN_VPN_VERSION`, set by `src-tauri/build.rs`), so an older service is offered Update. A change to the frames between them bumps `PROTOCOL_VERSION` instead, which makes the service unusable until it's updated.
- The repo is a Cargo workspace (`src-tauri`, `crates/vpn-proto`, `crates/vpn-worker`), so `target/` and `Cargo.lock` are at the root. `beforeBuildCommand` runs `scripts/vpn-worker.ts`, which builds the `fran-vpn` sidecar into `src-tauri/binaries/` (lipo'd for the universal macOS build) and on Windows fetches `wintun.dll`, checked against its SHA-256. `tauri build` gets `--config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json` (or `tauri.bundle.windows.conf.json`, which adds `wintun.dll` and the NSIS uninstall hook), since `externalBin` in the main config would make every `cargo check` need the sidecar.
- The tag runs `workflows/release.yml`: it checks the tag against `tauri.conf.json`, builds Windows (NSIS), macOS (universal, unsigned) and Linux (AppImage), then `scripts/deploy.ts` uploads to the `frandb-files` B2 bucket (served at `frandb.won.fyi`), creates the GitHub release with the installers attached, and writes `updater/latest.json` last.
- The `nix` job runs alongside the builds: it builds the flake on x86_64 and aarch64 Linux and pushes it to the `cache.kirsi.dev` niks3 cache. The flake takes its versions from `package.json` and `Cargo.toml`, so `version:bump` covers it. Once the deploy and the nix build both succeed, the `stable` branch is pushed to the tagged commit.
- The in-app updater (`src/states/updaterState.ts`, Settings > Updates) reads that manifest. Update files are signed with the `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` secret, which must match `plugins.updater.pubkey`.
- Repo secrets: `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY`, `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD`, `B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID`, `B2_APPLICATION_KEY`.
- `npm run tauri icon app-icon.svg` regenerates `src-tauri/icons/` from the SVG.
